notes: The tutorial offers two alternatives (potentiometer, or photoresistor + 10k resistor). The main circuit text describes the potentiometer, so that circuit is built; the photoresistor variant is not included.

Breadboard coordinates follow the potentiometer image, which is drawn rotated relative to the catalogue naming: the pot's two outer pins are in the image's lower half (rows a-e, bank 't', columns 10 and 12) and its wiper is in the upper half (bank 'b', column 11). Black wire (GND) is on column 10 and red wire (5V) on column 12, as drawn.

The built-in LED on pin 13 is not modelled as a separate part. The optional external circuit (220 ohm resistor and red LED) is included: pin 13 -> resistor -> LED anode, LED cathode -> GND. It has no image, so its breadboard positions and the use of GND.2 (the GND next to pin 13) are assumed.
The pot's GND/VCC ports are symmetric, so the end-for-end assignment of the outer pins is interchangeable.
